_comment: Resource policy for GitHub Actions. Read by scripts/ci_gate.py at the start of every run.
notes: paused: when true, the workflow runs the gate step only and skips the substantive work.
max_minutes_per_run must not exceed the job's timeout-minutes; the gate warns if it does.
max_runs_per_day counts entries in docs/ci/runs.jsonl for the current UTC date.
These limits are enforced by the workflow from files in the repository. GitHub's own billing
and minutes accounting are outside this repository's control and are not claimed here.
